MinSegmentDrawLength

Minimum length (in world units) that a segment must have to be drawn. Segments with a squared length less than ShapeEngine.Geometry.SegmentDef.Segment.MinSegmentDrawLengthSquared are skipped to avoid rendering extremely short or degenerate geometry that can cause visual artifacts or unnecessary draw calls.

DrawGapped(float, LineDrawingInfo, GappedOutlineDrawingInfo)

Draws a segment with gaps, creating a dashed or segmented effect.

public float DrawGapped(float length, LineDrawingInfo lineInfo, GappedOutlineDrawingInfo gapDrawingInfo)

Parameters

length float

The length of the segment. If zero or negative, the method calculates it automatically. Providing a known length avoids redundant calculations and improves performance, especially for static segments.

lineInfo LineDrawingInfo

Parameters describing how to draw the segment.

gapDrawingInfo GappedOutlineDrawingInfo

Parameters describing the gap configuration.

Returns

float

Returns the segment length if positive; otherwise, returns -1. If the shape does not change, the valid length can be reused in subsequent frames to avoid recalculating.

Remarks

This is a convenience wrapper for DrawGappedSegment(Vector2, Vector2, float, LineDrawingInfo, GappedOutlineDrawingInfo).

DrawGappedSegment(Vector2, Vector2, float, LineDrawingInfo, GappedOutlineDrawingInfo)

Draws a line segment with gaps, creating a dashed or segmented effect.

public static float DrawGappedSegment(Vector2 start, Vector2 end, float length, LineDrawingInfo lineInfo, GappedOutlineDrawingInfo gapDrawingInfo)

Parameters

start Vector2

The starting point of the line segment.

end Vector2

The ending point of the line segment.

length float

The length of the line. If zero or negative, the method calculates it automatically. Providing a known length avoids redundant calculations and improves performance, especially for static segments.

lineInfo LineDrawingInfo

Parameters describing how to draw the line (e.g., color, thickness).

gapDrawingInfo GappedOutlineDrawingInfo

Parameters describing the gap configuration (number of gaps, gap percentage, etc.).

Returns

float

The length of the line if positive; otherwise, -1. If the shape does not change, the valid length can be reused in subsequent frames to avoid recalculating.

Remarks

  • If gapDrawingInfo.Gaps.Gaps is 0 or gapDrawingInfo.GapPerimeterPercentage.GapPerimeterPercentage is 0, the line is drawn solid.
  • If gapDrawingInfo.GapPerimeterPercentage.GapPerimeterPercentage is 1 or greater, no line is drawn.

DrawMasked(Circle, LineDrawingInfo, bool)

Draws the portion(s) of this segment that are masked by the provided mask circle.

public void DrawMasked(Circle mask, LineDrawingInfo lineInfo, bool reversedMask = false)

Parameters

mask Circle

Circle used as a closed mask for clipping the segment.

lineInfo LineDrawingInfo

Drawing parameters (thickness, color, cap type and cap points).

reversedMask bool

If false draw the parts of the segment outside the circle (default). If true draw the parts of the segment inside the circle.

Remarks

Intersection computations are delegated to IntersectCircle(Circle). Handles cases where both endpoints are inside, both outside with two intersections, a single intersection, or no intersections.

DrawMasked(Polygon, LineDrawingInfo, bool)

Draws the portion(s) of this segment that are masked by the provided mask polygon.

public void DrawMasked(Polygon mask, LineDrawingInfo lineInfo, bool reversedMask = false)

Parameters

mask Polygon

Polygon used as a closed mask for clipping the segment.

lineInfo LineDrawingInfo

Drawing parameters (thickness, color, cap type and cap points).

reversedMask bool

If false draw the parts of the segment outside the polygon (default). If true draw the parts of the segment inside the polygon.

Remarks

Intersection computations are delegated to IntersectPolygon(Polygon, int). Handles cases where there are zero, one, or multiple intersection points. When multiple intersections are returned, the method augments the intersection list with the segment endpoints and sorts them to determine alternating inside/outside intervals before drawing the appropriate subsegments.

DrawMasked(Rect, LineDrawingInfo, bool)

DrawMasked(Triangle, LineDrawingInfo, bool)

Draws the portion(s) of this segment that are masked by the provided mask triangle.

public void DrawMasked(Triangle mask, LineDrawingInfo lineInfo, bool reversedMask = false)

Parameters

mask Triangle

Triangle used as a closed mask for clipping the segment.

lineInfo LineDrawingInfo

Drawing parameters (thickness, color, cap type and cap points).

reversedMask bool

If false draw the parts of the segment outside the triangle (default). If true draw the parts of the segment inside the triangle.

Remarks

This method handles the following cases:

  • Both endpoints inside the triangle (draws whole segment when reversedMask is true).
  • Both endpoints outside with two intersection points (draws subsegments determined by intersections).
  • Single intersection point (draws the appropriate subsegment depending on which endpoint is inside).
  • No intersections (draws whole segment when outside and reversedMask is false). Intersection computations are delegated to IntersectTriangle(Triangle).

DrawMasked<T>(T, LineDrawingInfo, bool)

Draws the portion(s) of this segment that are masked by a generic closed-shape mask. This generic overload dispatches to the concrete shape-specific overload (Circle, Triangle, Quad, Rect, or Polygon) based on mask.GetClosedShapeType().

public void DrawMasked<T>(T mask, LineDrawingInfo lineInfo, bool reversedMask = false) where T : IClosedShapeTypeProvider

Parameters

mask T

The mask shape that provides its closed-shape type. The method will attempt to cast to the concrete shape type.

lineInfo LineDrawingInfo

Drawing parameters (thickness, color, cap type and cap points).

reversedMask bool

If false draw the parts of the segment outside the mask (default). If true draw the parts of the segment inside the mask.

Type Parameters

T

A type that implements IClosedShapeTypeProvider and represents the mask shape.

Remarks

If the concrete mask type is not one of the supported closed shapes, no drawing occurs. Use the concrete overloads when the exact mask type is known to avoid the runtime dispatch and cast.

smoothness float

The smoothness value (0-1). This controls the visual quality of the circle by inversely interpolating the current CircleSideLengthRange. A value of 0 uses the maximum side length (fewer sides, less smooth), while 1 uses the minimum side length (more sides, smoother). The resulting side length determines the number of polygon sides used to approximate the circle.

ProjectShape(Polygon, Vector2, bool)

Projects the segment along the given vector and writes the convex hull of the combined point set into result.

public bool ProjectShape(Polygon result, Vector2 v, bool useBuffer = false)

Parameters

result Polygon

The destination polygon that receives the convex hull of the original and projected segment endpoints.

v Vector2

The vector along which to project the segment.

useBuffer bool

true to reuse the internal points buffer and avoid a temporary allocation; false to allocate a new temporary buffer. Set this to false when calling from parallel or multi-threaded code, since the internal buffer is shared and not thread-safe.

Returns

bool

true if v is non-zero and result was populated; otherwise, false.

Remarks

This method forms a temporary four-point set consisting of the segment endpoints and those same endpoints translated by v, then computes the convex hull into result.

ProjectShape(Vector2, bool)

Returns the convex hull polygon formed by projecting the segment along a given vector.

public Polygon? ProjectShape(Vector2 v, bool useBuffer = false)

Parameters

v Vector2

The vector along which to project the segment.

useBuffer bool

true to reuse the internal points buffer and avoid a temporary allocation; false to allocate a new temporary buffer. Set this to false when calling from parallel or multi-threaded code, since the internal buffer is shared and not thread-safe.

Returns

Polygon

A Polygon representing the convex hull, or null if the vector is zero.

Remarks

The result is typically a quadrilateral, unless the vector is degenerate.
